intro: Open source is where I learned to build software with other people. A CV tool that students forked, a GitHub Action that deployed this site for years, and a few programs that taught me to read code before writing it. Everything here is public so someone else can start from it.

quote.text: Talk is cheap. Show me the code.
quote.author: Linus Torvalds

programs.name: GirlScript Summer of Code
programs.work: Contributed to the development of a book-donation Flutter app steered by the GirlScript Foundation.

programs.name: Kharagpur Winter of Code
programs.work: Student developer in KWoC, IIT Kharagpur's winter open-source program.

programs.name: Hacktoberfest
programs.work: Successfully completed DigitalOcean's Hacktoberfest in 2020 and 2021.

repositories.name: CV-Buddy
repositories.summary: Build your CV in an easy and simple way using templates. Forked and extended by other students.

repositories.name: static-build-export-action
repositories.summary: A GitHub Action that builds a static site and exports the output to a dedicated branch on every push; it deployed this portfolio for years.

repositories.name: DevPort
repositories.summary: Developer portfolio built with Gatsby and GraphQL, continuously deployed to GitHub Pages through Actions. Open source so others can fork it.

repositories.name: Smaller repositories
repositories.summary: Registration-form (saves submissions to a Google Sheet via Apps Script), chatbot (a static JavaScript chatbot driven by a JSON flow), utility-leaves-calendar.
